answer.justification: Antibiotic-associated watery diarrhea with gram-positive anaerobic rods indicates Clostridioides difficile, whose spores resist alcohols, iodophors, and quaternary ammonium agents. Environmental decontamination requires a chlorine-based sporicidal solution, such as hypochlorite/bleach, to prevent room transmission.
